notes.srand: FUN_007e8153, unlabelled in the project: call _getptd (0x7EDB13); mov ecx,[esp+4]; mov [eax+0x14],ecx; ret. It stores the seed in the same per-thread field (_tiddata._holdrand, offset 0x14) that rand reads, which is VC6's multithreaded srand.

notes.getptd: FUN_007edb13, unlabelled in the project (query.py _getptd: not found; 0x7EDB13: FUN_007edb13). It is VC6's _getptd: GetLastError (IAT 0x847284); TlsGetValue([_tlsindex 0x8C23F0]) (IAT 0x8471C0); if null, _calloc_crt(1, 0x74), TlsSetValue (IAT 0x8471B8), _initptd (0x7EDB00), _tid = GetCurrentThreadId (IAT 0x847288), _thandle = -1, else _amsg_exit(0x10); SetLastError (IAT 0x84714C); returns the _tiddata. srand (0x7E8153) and rand (0x7E8160) both call it and use [eax+0x14]. Found from the call in rand, confirmed by objdump -d of 0x7EDB13-0x7EDB7A. The oracle calls it once at the snapshot, on the thread that runs the cases.
